PokéBacon Studio — asset sources

v4.3.2 rain puddles: original Pokemon Emerald Fortree/Route 120 metatiles
0x274, 0x275, 0x27c, 0x27d, decoded from General/Fortree tiles/palettes:
https://github.com/pret/pokeemerald/tree/master/data/tilesets/secondary/fortree
The 32x32 stamp retains native pixels with exterior grass made transparent.
Connected terrain joins are composed from those shore pixels. These are static
visual assets; native reflections/splash effects are not included. Original game
artwork retains Nintendo / Creatures Inc. / GAME FREAK inc. ownership.

Native-sized cutouts and structural building strips prepared for PokéBacon Studio.
Kanto: included Pokémon source profile, FRLG.
Johto-style interiors: native-size reference artwork from a compatible Gen III source profile. Some service buildings reuse Kanto artwork; Emerald-style furniture is shared where labelled.
Hoenn exteriors: original Emerald Petalburg City/general tiles, palettes and metatiles from the primary decompilation https://github.com/pret/pokeemerald ; native source references and crop rectangles are recorded in catalog provenance. No whole ROM or full native atlas is bundled.
Hoenn interiors: Emerald-compatible Centre and Battle Frontier art retained from the compatible source profile. The Mart set intentionally reuses that profile's Emerald-style Mart art.
All game artwork retains its original creators' ownership and usage terms. Original pixels and source attribution are preserved.

Additional furnishings, trees and themes: Ekat Public Tiles / Ekat Tiny Interiors. See ekat-public-tiles.txt and tiny-interiors.txt for Ekat, Heartlessdragoon and other original contributor terms. Summer Blues, Fancy Centre, Pink Lemonade, home/cabin/cellar/League-style themes retain their source attribution. League-style is an Ekat arena theme, not an official Indigo Plateau interior.

Background removal clears only outdoor scenery or floor pixels around cutouts. Structural extension strips copy native pixel fragments without scaling, signs, logos or door duplication. Per-item provenance in assets/creator/catalog.json records source assets, maps and crop coordinates. The Indigo League building is frontage-only; its original full roof is not present in the supplied map crop.

Furnishings are visual objects with movement defaults. A pictured PC, machine, counter or shop does not automatically provide its game functionality.

Native HM preview sprites (v1.7): Cut tree, Rock Smash rock and Strength boulder,
16 × 16, extracted from a compatible source profile at native scale.
New ROM-bound placements decode the opened ROM's matching graphics and palette.
Original game artwork retains its original usage terms. No complete atlas/ROM
is included. mGBA runtime licence/source: ../../vendor/mgba/NOTICE.txt.

45 additional objects and 17 portal styles: exact crops of the supplied Ekat Public Tiles sheets. Source rectangles, cleanup masks and original sheet IDs are retained in prefab provenance. Retain original Ekat credits. No generated recolours.

Additional fence gate templates (v3): composed from existing Ekat Public Tiles and included Kanto rail kits at their native pixel scale. Thistle, Classic iron and Dreamyard gate pieces retain Ekat's original contributor credits in ekat-public-tiles.txt. Kanto gate pieces retain Nintendo / Creatures Inc. / GAME FREAK inc. and verified source profile attribution in kanto-paths.txt. These open states are transparent compositions retaining original support pieces; they are not extracted gate-animation frames. Genuine vertical side silhouettes remain separate for west and east enclosure sides. No new ROM or complete native tileset is included.


v3.2 reusable interiors and furniture:
108 named interior layouts, 34 loose furnishing crops and 6 landmark exteriors are native-size artwork from a compatible FRLG-style source profile. Original game pixels retain Nintendo / Creatures Inc. / GAME FREAK inc. ownership and their applicable source terms. Source hashes, map keys/names, crop rectangles and original metatile-plane provenance are recorded in assets/interior-templates-v32/catalog.json. Only deduplicated used plane tiles and individual crops are supplied; no full ROM, complete native tileset, scripts or NPC records are bundled. Map naming reference: https://github.com/pret/pokefirered/blob/master/data/maps/map_groups.json .
42 additional home/shop/game-room/beach-house furniture crops and 4 sets use Ekat Public Tiles at their native scale. Source sheets, crop rectangles, alpha cleanup and hashes are recorded in assets/interiors-v32/catalog.json. Retain Ekat Public Tiles / Tiny Interiors contributor terms in the adjacent credit files.
